THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/508 dated 27.10.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village called Kaddukarankudiyiruppu in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/53, of Kaddukaran Kudiyiruppu in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follow:

01. Lot 'A' – Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani – Extent: 2.3365 Hectares North: Lot B and Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known); East: Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known); South: Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known), Nachialkaani (Claimed by A.Amirthanathan Thatcroos and shareholders), and Lot C; West: Lot C, Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known) and Lot B.

02. Lot 'B' – Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani – Extent: 0.0071 Hectare North: Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known); East: Lot A; South: Lot A and Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known); West: Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known).

03. Lot 'C' – Nachialkaani – Extent: 0.5464 Hectare North: Lot A; East: Lot A, Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known) and Nachialkaani (Claimed by A.Amirthanathan Thatcroos and shareholders); South: Nachialkaani (Claimed by A.Amirthanathan Thatcroos and shareholders); West: Nachialkaani (Claimed by A.Amirthanathan Thatcroos and shareholders)and Kaddukarankudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known).
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/11/2023/RE/125.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.01st February 2024.
